## S&P 500 and Dow Futures Drop as Trump Declares Iran 'Totally Defeated' and Brent Crude Tops $92

For a tech PM, Brent above $92 combined with geopolitical escalation tightens the macro backdrop — higher energy costs feed into data center opex and compress sentiment broadly; a risk-off equity open is a tactical signal to monitor position sizing in high-beta tech names and evaluate the duration of the macro overhang.

- President Trump stated Iran is 'totally defeated,' triggering a geopolitical risk-off move in equity futures.
- Brent crude topped $92, adding an energy cost shock to the macro outlook.
- S&P 500 and Dow futures fell in response to the combined signals.
- The simultaneous geopolitical escalation, commodity spike, and equity futures weakness constitute a tri-factor macro headwind.
